content: Cookiecutter Data Science (drivendata) is the de-facto standard structure for solo/small-team data science projects: data/{raw,interim,processed,external} for immutable-raw-to-processed data lineage; src/ package with dataset.py (ingestion), features.py (feature engineering), modeling/{train.py,predict.py}, plots.py; notebooks/ for exploration numbered by step; Makefile for pipeline orchestration (make data, make train). Core principle: raw data is read-only/immutable, all derived data regenerable from src/ + data/raw.
